feeds.title: Rediscover the 80s
feeds.description: Rediscover the '80s is dedicated to rediscovering 1980s pop culture and exploring its influence in the modern day. Since 2011, RD80s has been creating written features, review videos, and audio podcasts to help preserve everything we love from the decade of decadence.

feeds.title: Forgotten 80s Blog
feeds.description: Lost classics + rare treats from a great musical decade. Tune in to Absolute 80s to hear Human League, U2, Frankie Goes to Hollywood, Simple Minds, Duran Duran, Prince, ABC, Depeche Mode, Blondie and Bon Jovi, plus a sprinkling of timeless tunes from artists such as Bananarama, Culture Club and Madonna.

feeds.title: Slicing Up Eyeballs
feeds.description: Slicing Up Eyeballs celebrates the legacy of '80s college, modern and indie rock, the music - once relegated to campus radio, pioneering commercial stations like San Diego's 91X and the Sunday night ghetto of MTV's '120 Minutes' - that paved the way for Nirvana and the alternative revolution.

feeds.title: Rave and Roll
feeds.description: Uncovering 80s obscurity ~ one song at a time. By a David Bowie fan.

feeds.title: Retro Injection
feeds.description: Retroinjection.com is a great '80s and '90s blog. We review classic movies, retro toys and arcade video games. If you like old video stores and VHS tapes, you'll love Retro Injection!

feeds.title: 80s baby

feeds.title: 80sneverend
feeds.description: The project 80sneverend was created in 2011 with the orignal name of 80and30 as a facebook group aimed to re-live the 80s, exactly after thirty years. It has evolved into a facebook page and into a community and then into this blog. The purpose of the project has not changed, anyway: to re-live the 80s, celebrating music, songs, stories, characters, and everything that was on top of our minds in the most beautiful decade ever.
